𝐈𝐍 𝐏𝐇𝐎𝐓𝐎𝐒 || Upon arrival at the scene, the responding EMS team found both students seated on chairs inside the school clinic. Both patients were conscious but experiencing difficulty breathing, hyperventilation, and generalized body malaise. These symptoms were possibly associated with anxiety following the school incident the previous day.
EMS personnel provided initial first aid and reassurance to help calm the patients and manage their breathing. Both patients were subsequently assisted into the ambulance for further assessment. Their vital signs and overall conditions were continuously monitored while preparing for transport to a medical facility for further evaluation and management.
Both students were transported to the Titay Rural Health Unit (RHU) for further medical evaluation and treatment.
The responding team arrived at the Titay Rural Health Unit (RHU), where both students were properly endorsed to the physician on duty.
